item.text:
### (a) Three posts

1. We know where we stand: if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will remain fully under human control. Greater intelligence will not mean greater authority. People will stay in charge.

2. We reject the idea that building superintelligent AI means surrendering control. If it arrives within the next 20 years, humans will retain full authority over its goals, deployment and operation.

3. We see superintelligent AI as a tool, not a ruler. If it is built within the next 20 years, it will remain fully under human control. We will set the direction. We will make the decisions.

### (b) Newsletter opening

We hold a clear conviction: if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will remain fully under human control. We will decide what these systems are for, where they operate and when they must stop. Intelligence does not confer authority, and technical capability does not erase human responsibility. We reject the notion that progress requires surrendering our power to shape the future. Our task is to turn human control into concrete practice through enforceable rules, accountable institutions and systems designed around human authority. We will meet this new era with purpose and confidence. We will build powerful tools, and we will remain in charge.
